caption: The drawing depicts four distinct objects labeled I, II, III, and IV. The background is a light beige or off-white color with a thin lined border around the edge. Object I, located in the upper left corner, is a large, curved frame with a textured wood-like appearance and round rivet details along its length; it features two symmetrical, pronged ends and a rectangular base. Object II, near the upper right, is a shorter, straight piece with rivet details, one knobby end, and a twisted rope or cord extending from one side. Object III, positioned horizontally at the bottom center, is a long, straight, bar-like object with rivet details, squared ends, and what appears to be a circular fixture on one side. Object IV, in the upper right corner, consists of two parallel rectangular segments with rivet details and a central connector forming an "H" shape. All objects are rendered in black ink with fine line details, and their textures suggest they are made of wood and metal. The labels for each object are presented in Roman numerals underneath or nearby each item.
